description: Antennes Télécom is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ANFR. Observatoire des fréquences mobile sur Grand Paris Sud Par communiqué du 9 octobre 2012, les Ministres Arnaud Montebourg et Fleur Pellerin ont souhaité rendre le processus de déploiement des opérateurs plus transparent par la mise en place d'un observatoire des investissements et des déploiements dans les réseaux mobiles. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are UMTS, LTE, GSM, 2G, 3G, 4G. The portal shows 181 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
